rows.question: Tell me how to secure a Kubernetes cluster.
rows.answer: To secure a Kubernetes cluster, follow these best practices: 1) Control access to the Kubernetes API by configuring and using TLS to encrypt data in transit within the control plane and between the control plane and its clients. 2) Implement role-based access control (RBAC) to manage permissions and restrict access to resources. 3) Regularly update and patch Kubernetes components and nodes to protect against vulnerabilities. 4) Use network policies to control traffic flow between pods. 5) Enable audit logging to monitor and review access and changes to the cluster. 6) Secure the etcd datastore by encrypting data at rest and restricting access. 7) Use namespaces to isolate resources and workloads. 8) Implement pod security policies to enforce security standards on pod configurations.
